themes.description: Users have reported several UI-related issues, including overlapping icons on the search and 'Prime' icon, small block sizes in the Equity section, and a cluttered interface.
themes.business_impact: UI issues may lead to increased frustration and decreased user satisfaction, potentially resulting in negative word-of-mouth and a loss of customers.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient UI testing and a lack of design consistency may have led to these UI issues.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct a thorough UI audit to identify and fix design inconsistencies
• Update the 'Prime' icon and search icon to prevent overlapping
• Increase the size of blocks in the Equity section to match those in the FNO section.

themes.description: Users report frequent issues with customer support, citing slow responses, unhelpful representatives, and difficulties with resolving issues.
themes.business_impact: Poor customer support may lead to increased frustration, decreased customer satisfaction, and potentially, negative word-of-mouth and loss of business.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Inadequate training for customer support staff or insufficient resources may contribute to the poor quality of support.
themes.action_plan: • Provide additional training for customer support staff, ensure sufficient resources are allocated, and implement clear communication protocols to improve response times.

themes.description: Users are expressing frustration with the high brokerage fees charged by the platform, citing it as a major drawback for trading.
themes.business_impact: High brokerage fees are resulting in reduced profitability for users and potentially driving them away from the platform.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The high brokerage fees are likely due to the business model or profit margins of the platform.
themes.action_plan:
• Review and optimize the business model to reduce profit margins
• Introduce tiered pricing or discounts for frequent traders
• Provide clear transparency on brokerage fees and associated costs.
